senses.sense_definition: A Himalayan flowering plant of the species Morina longifolia, noted for its aromatic foliage and spiny whorls of flowers.

examples.text: The gardener added a rare <w>whorlflower</w> to the alpine section of the botanical garden.
Native to high altitudes, the <w>whorlflower</w> thrives in well-drained, rocky soil.
